<a name="classmap"></a>
## class Caligrafy\ClassMap

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class ClassMap
```

Source: [framework/core/ClassMap.php:24](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/ClassMap.php#L24)

Class ClassMap (2.18.0)
Before 2.18.0 the first unknown class of a request loaded every PHP file of framework/core, framework/database,
framework/interfaces, application/ and tests/. Now a map of class =&gt; file (namespaced or not, interfaces, traits and
enums too) is built once from those folders (application/config, application/views and tests/ left out) and kept in a
private folder of the temporary directory; a class is loaded when it is first used.

Kept as before: a file that does more than declare classes (it declares functions, or runs code at the top level, or
declares a class inside an if) is loaded at start, as every file used to be. A class missing from the map, and the
list of capabilities, make the map check its files (once per request; with APP_ENV=production at most once a
minute): a file added, removed or changed since the map was built rebuilds it, so a new class works at once while
you develop. A new container starts with no map. CLASS_MAP=false in .env goes back to loading every file.

### Constants

+ `VERSION = 2`
+ `PRODUCTION_CHECK = 60`

<a name="doctor"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Doctor

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Doctor
```

Source: [framework/core/Doctor.php:22](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Doctor.php#L22)

Class Doctor
Every check is read-only: it lists, reads or connects, it never creates, charges or sends anything
(the only exception is Watson when its assistants cannot be listed: a session is opened and closed right away).
Secret values are never printed: at most a known prefix and the last 4 characters.

Base URLs can be overridden (tests, proxies, regional endpoints): OPENAI_API_BASE, GROQ_API_BASE, AGENT_API_BASE,
STRIPE_API_BASE, COINBASE_API_BASE. Watson always uses WATSON_URL.

### Constants

+ `CHECKS =['project', 'database', 'openai', 'groq', 'agent', 'stripe', 'coinbase', 'watson', 'mail']`
+ `LABELS = ...`
+ `TIMEOUT = 8`
+ `PLACEHOLDERS =['your-smtp-host', 'pk_test_1234', 'sk_test_1234', 'pk_live_1234', 'sk_live_1234']`

<a name="updater"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Updater

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Updater
```

Source: [framework/core/Updater.php:26](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Updater.php#L26)

Class Updater
php caligrafer.php update [&lt;version&gt;] downloads the project's release (Framework::VERSION) and the target release
(the latest by default), then:
1. framework/ and claude-plugin/ are the framework's: replaced whole (files the release dropped go too), except the files initialize writes there (KEEP). Framework files changed by hand are named in the report
2. every other file of the release (caligrafer.php, .bin/, Dockerfile, index.php, public/css, public/js...) is compared with the project's release: an untouched copy is replaced, a missing one added, a changed one kept with the new version written next to it (&lt;file&gt;.caligrafy-new). Documents (DOCS) changed by hand are left alone
3. composer.json gets the new packages and versions the project did not change (then composer update for them), .gitignore the new lines, .env the new settings with their defaults (existing values are never changed)
4. php caligrafer.php upgrade --apply, from the new release, brings application/ up to date
Everything replaced is copied first to backups/caligrafy-update-&lt;from&gt;-to-&lt;to&gt;-&lt;time&gt;/. --check reports only.
application/, .env values, public/uploads and vendor/ are never replaced.

### Constants

+ `REPOSITORY = 'caligrafy/caligrafy-quill'`
+ `WHOLE = array('framework', 'claude-plugin')`
+ `KEEP = array('framework/librairies/app/.env')`
+ `SKIP = ...`
+ `MERGED = array('composer.json', '.gitignore')`
+ `DOCS = array('README.md', 'CHANGELOG.md', 'CONTRIBUTING.md', 'CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md', 'ARCHITECTURE.md', 'LICENSE')`
+ `NEW_SUFFIX = '.caligrafy-new'`
+ `ENV_EXAMPLE = 'framework/settings/.env.example'`

### Methods

+ [`->__construct()`](#updater-construct)
+ [`->run()`](#updater-run)
+ [`->newerRelease()`](#updater-newerrelease)
+ [`->download()`](#updater-download)

<a name="upgrader"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Upgrader

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Upgrader
```

Source: [framework/core/Upgrader.php:18](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Upgrader.php#L18)

Class Upgrader
Compares application/ with framework/settings/application and reports or applies the template updates.
Only template files are touched; files you created, .env, public/uploads and vendor are never read or written.
Client apps in public/ created from framework/plugins are reported only, and so are .env (new and obsolete settings)
and the views or apps that still use Bootstrap 3 classes (the framework uses Bootstrap 5).

### Constants

+ `TEMPLATE = 'framework/settings/application'`
+ `HISTORY = 'framework/settings/template-history.json'`
+ `USER_SERVICES = 'services/Users/'`
+ `ADMIN_CONTROLLER = 'controllers/core/Auth/AdminController.php'`
+ `AUTH_CONTROLLER = 'controllers/core/Auth/AuthController.php'`
+ `PLUGINS = 'framework/plugins'`
+ `MANIFEST = '.caligrafy-manifest.json'`
+ `ROUTES = 'config/routing/web.php'`
+ `NEW_SUFFIX = '.caligrafy-new'`
+ `MANIFEST_FORMAT = 1`
+ `PLUGIN_MARKERS =['facedetect' => 'new FaceDetector', 'ml' => 'new MlCore', 'bot' => '__bots__', 'app' => 'loadVue(']`
+ `BOOTSTRAP3 = ...`
+ `OBSOLETE_SETTINGS =['CRYPTO_PAY_KEY' => 'Coinbase Commerce closed on March 31, 2026: use COINBASE_API_KEY_NAME and COINBASE_API_KEY_SECRET (Coinbase Business)']`

<a name="deployer"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Deployer

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Deployer
```

Source: [framework/core/Deployer.php:23](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Deployer.php#L23)

Class Deployer
1. waits for the database (a new server starts its database at the same time as the app)
2. creates the framework tables (framework/settings/platform.sql, safe to run again)
3. runs every application/models/&lt;folder&gt;/create_db.sql that is new or changed since its last run, and records it in caligrafy_scripts. A script that drops, deletes or truncates is never run again once it ran: run it by hand (php caligrafer.php sql &lt;file&gt;) when you mean it. seed.sql and other scripts are never run. A statement that adds a column, an index or a foreign key already there (the script's earlier run added it) is skipped, so a script keeps its ALTER TABLE ... ADD statements.
4. runs the migrations of application/migrations that never ran (Migrations, 2.18.0)
Without DB_ACTIVATE=true there is nothing to do.

### Constants

+ `SCRIPTS_TABLE = 'caligrafy_scripts'`
+ `DESTRUCTIVE = '/\b(DROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA|VIEW|COLUMN)|DELETE\s+FROM|TRUNCATE)\b/i'`

### Methods

+ [`->__construct()`](#deployer-construct)
+ [`->run()`](#deployer-run)
+ [`Deployer::cacheEnv()`](#deployer-cacheenv)
+ [`->schedule()`](#deployer-schedule)
+ [`->scripts()`](#deployer-scripts)
+ [`Deployer::destructive()`](#deployer-destructive)
+ [`Deployer::alreadyApplied()`](#deployer-alreadyapplied)

<a name="cloudclient"></a>
## class Caligrafy\CloudClient

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class CloudClient
```

Source: [framework/core/CloudClient.php:19](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/CloudClient.php#L19)

Class CloudClient
Calls the capabilities of Caligrafy Cloud (POST &lt;url&gt;/capabilities/&lt;name&gt;) with a personal access token of the
account. `cloud login` gets it by itself: it opens &lt;url&gt;/cli?code=..., the owner approves the code shown in the
terminal, and the command collects the token (start_cli_login, poll_cli_login). --token or --paste take one created
on the dashboard instead. The token is kept in .caligrafy/cloud.json of the project (git-ignored, never in the
image), or given with CALIGRAFY_CLOUD_TOKEN. CALIGRAFY_CLOUD_URL points to another service.

### Constants

+ `DEFAULT_URL = 'https://deploy.caligrafy.com'`
+ `PERIODS = array('week', 'month', 'year')`

<a name="quickstart"></a>
## class Caligrafy\Quickstart

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class Quickstart
```

Source: [framework/core/Quickstart.php:23](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/Quickstart.php#L23)

Class Quickstart
Every step can be run again: it only does what is missing.
1. application/ (initialize; it deletes the .git folder of the framework, so it needs --yes when one exists)
2. .env: the database of the Docker server (DB_ACTIVATE=true, DB_HOST=mysql, a database name), or, on a local server (MAMP, XAMPP, LAMP), the address of the project in its web folder (APP_ROOT) and its MySQL settings (asked with the stack's defaults; without a terminal to confirm them, skipped unless --db-defaults)
3. the database and the framework tables (tokens, audit log)
4. web.php: Route::capabilities('/capabilities') for the JS client, Route::mcp('/mcp') for AI agents and Route::notifications() for the links of notification emails
5. with --example: the Tasks example (capabilities, page, REST routes, table, JS client)

### Constants

+ `EXAMPLE = 'framework/settings/examples/tasks'`
+ `LOCAL_STACKS = ...`
+ `DEFAULT_DATABASE = 'caligrafy'`
+ `DOCKER_SERVICES = array('dev-box' => array(80, '8080'), 'prod-box' => array(80, '8080'), 'phpmyadmin' => array(80, '8077'), 'mysql' => array(3306, '3306'))`: Runs the steps
+ `COMPOSE_FILES = ...`

<a name="pluginsource"></a>
## class Caligrafy\PluginSource

```php
namespace Caligrafy;

class PluginSource
```

Source: [framework/core/PluginSource.php:22](https://github.com/caligrafy/caligrafy-quill/blob/v2.25.0/framework/core/PluginSource.php#L22)

Class PluginSource
A project enables the Claude Code plugin of its own claude-plugin/ folder through .claude/settings.json: a plugin
source (a "marketplace", declared in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json) at "./", and the plugin caligrafy-quill@&lt;name&gt;.
Claude Code keeps one source per name for the whole computer: when every project calls it "caligrafy", the first
project opened wins, every other project gets that project's plugin (an older one), and none gets any once that
folder is deleted. initialize and update give the project its own name: caligrafy-&lt;folder&gt;-&lt;4 hex&gt;.
The framework's own repository keeps "caligrafy": it is the source people add from GitHub.
Claude Code runs a copy of the plugin it makes at install time (~/.claude/plugins/cache), not the project's folder:
after an update brings a newer claude-plugin/, connect() refreshes that copy, and doctor warns while it is older.

### Constants

+ `SHARED = 'caligrafy'`
+ `PLUGIN = 'caligrafy-quill'`
+ `SETTINGS = '.claude/settings.json'`
+ `MARKETPLACE = '.claude-plugin/marketplace.json'`
+ `MANIFEST = 'claude-plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json'`

### Methods

+ [`PluginSource::name()`](#pluginsource-name)
+ [`PluginSource::ensureOwn()`](#pluginsource-ensureown)
+ [`PluginSource::registeredPath()`](#pluginsource-registeredpath)
+ [`PluginSource::projectVersion()`](#pluginsource-projectversion)
+ [`PluginSource::installedVersion()`](#pluginsource-installedversion)
+ [`PluginSource::connect()`](#pluginsource-connect)
+ [`PluginSource::isFramework()`](#pluginsource-isframework)

Registers the project's plugin source with Claude Code on this computer and installs the plugin for the project
